snippet.title: Forgotlings | Launch Trailer - Consoles out June 18th!
snippet.description:
--update: PS5 & Xbox Series X|S arriving June 18th 2026!
"Its time to... remember"
It has been a long journey but we are super happy and proud to finally announce that Forgotlings is out on Steam!

Forgotlings is a cinematic adventure game set in the forgotten lands – a magical realm inhabited by sentient forgotten objects, called “forgotlings". In the game you play as the posing doll Fig, on a quest to unite the five tribes to come together against a common threat. The game is partly 2D hand-animated in a studio Ghibli inspired style and the backgrounds are hand painted. It is a follow-up to our previous award-winning title, Forgotton Anne (2018).

🎮 Play Forgotlings on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2059570/Forgotlings/

✨ Learn more about Forgotlings:
https://www.throughlinegames.com/forgotlings

💬 Join our Discord server:
https://discord.gg/kYBN8B2YhJ
